text:
maya_k: Hi all — I accepted the GitHub org invite but when I go to the repos tab it says 0 repos and trying to clone private repo gives 403. Anyone seen this?
julia-devex: @maya_k can you paste the exact git error and confirm the GitHub username you accepted with? sometimes people accept with personal account by accident.
maya_k: Error when cloning: 
```
Cloning into 'redwood-infra'...
remote: Repository not found.
fatal: repository 'https://github.com/redwood/redwood-infra.git/' not found
```
My GH username is maya-k (I accepted from the link in welcome email).
invite-bot: Invite accepted: maya-k <maya.personal@example.com> (timestamp: 1767777789)
matt-infra: Ok two quick things to check: 1) are you logged into the same GH account in the browser as `maya-k`? 2) Did the org prompt you to connect SSO after accepting? If you accepted via a personal email address we keep you as an outside collaborator until SSO/scim links the account.
maya_k: I'm logged in as maya-k and I did not see an SSO prompt. I just clicked the invite link and accepted.
julia-devex: If invite-bot shows a personal email that's the clue. Our org enforces SSO for private repos, and GitHub will block access until your account is linked to the corporate SSO identity.
matt-infra: Run this to check membership status: 
```
curl -s -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" https://api.github.com/orgs/redwood/memberships/maya-k
```
If it shows "role": "none" or "state": "pending", that's why. Also there can be a SCIM provisioning lag (People Ops sets teams, SCIM applies).
lisa-peopleops: I can force-reprovision if needed. @maya_k can you confirm your work email (the one on your new-hires invite)?
maya_k: It's maya.k@redwood.ai
lisa-peopleops: Thanks — I see you accepted but the account linked to maya.personal@example.com. I will revoke the pending outside-collab invite and resend to your work address so you can accept and get SSO prompt.
matt-infra: Once you accept with the work email, please visit https://github.com/orgs/redwood/sso and click "Authorize". That usually fixes repo access. If it still fails, ping me and I can add you to the repo team directly (temporary).
maya_k: Thanks! I got the new invite email and accepted using my work email. I also clicked Authorize on the SSO page.
invite-bot: Membership updated: maya-k -> member (timestamp: 1767778220)
matt-infra: Give it a minute for SCIM to add team memberships. If you still see 0 repos after 2m, try logging out and back in.
maya_k: Logging out/in fixed it — I can see the repos now and clone worked. Thanks everyone :tada:
julia-devex: Awesome — welcome to the team! If you hit anything else related to perms, DM me and we can add a quick checklist to the onboarding doc.
lisa-peopleops: Filed a brief note in the onboarding tracker to prefer sending invites to work emails to avoid this. :+1:
